query:
UPDATE article_content
         SET checksum = $3, html = $4,
             tags = ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($5::text::jsonb)),
             enclosures = $6::text::jsonb, image_url = $7, image_title = $8
         WHERE feed_id = $1 AND seq = $2 AND checksum <> $3
         RETURNING seq
